results.title: Target is loopback API + explicitly named non-shared DB container
No SMS provider / Send-SMS hook / Phone MFA / anonymous sign-in is enabled: nothing on this stack can deliver a message
Toolchain under test
Migration defaults: enabled=false, signup_enabled=false, alias_guard_mode=off
Legacy Installer (alias), Showroom (alias + organization) and e-mail accounts built through the real Admin-API + RPC path
Posture observe is active
An anonymous caller CANNOT create an Auth user on the internal phone alias through GoTrue /signup [guard observing only]
Anonymous alias sign-up yields NO session [guard observing only]
A possession-less alias account cannot claim the number as a profile phone [guard observing only]
Observe mode: the anonymous alias sign-up is NOT blocked but IS recorded (no alias or number in the record)
An anonymous alias row does NOT block the real owner's account creation [guard observing only]
Anonymous sign-up on an EXISTING alias (also upper-cased) creates no second identity and changes nothing
Concurrent anonymous sign-ups on one alias produce at most one Auth user
A public /signup body cannot set raw_app_meta_data (forged grant marker never lands)
Forging the grant markers in the sign-up body (app_metadata AND user_metadata) cannot create an alias user [guard observing only]
Direct GoTrue PHONE sign-up is refused (no Auth user with auth.users.phone)
Anonymous (no credential) sign-in is refused
A signed-in e-mail user cannot swap their login e-mail for an alias directly
Anonymous /signup answer for a FREE alias vs an EXISTING phone account (GoTrue-owned, not gated)
observe: the OLD no-grant Admin creation of an alias user still works (the migration cannot break existing legitimate sign-up before the dependent flow is ready)
Legitimate sign-up: proof -> Admin createUser WITH the grant succeeds; the account is confirmed with one identity
The usual initialisation RPCs run as before (consent, account type, profile_set_phone, username)
A completed phone sign-up records the number as verified: attach -> profiles.phone_verified_at set, for the exact proven number
Verification grants nothing else: no auth.users.phone, no MFA factor, exactly the one e-mail identity
Rollback (Admin deleteUser) after a completed initialisation leaves no Auth user, identity, public user, profile or phone claim
After a rollback the SPENT grant cannot recreate the alias (replay): a new proof is required
...and a fresh proof for the same number creates the account again (no tombstone, no leaked reservation)
A verified signup challenge is bound to the NEW Auth user and sets profiles.phone_verified_at for exactly the verified number (and no other account's flag)
Replaying a consumed proof (same code and challenge), re-attaching, or re-using the grant to create a user are all refused and change nothing
An expired proof cannot be verified, and an expired grant cannot create or verify an account
A proof for number A cannot create/verify number B: a grant cannot create another alias, and the grant cannot be attached by another user or by a legacy account
...and neither attempt marked anything verified
Three concurrent Admin creations racing on ONE grant create exactly one account
Three concurrent attach calls for one grant verify exactly once
Three concurrent verifications of ONE correct code mint exactly one grant
Alias account creation without a valid proof is refused at the database, through GoTrue sign-up AND the Admin API [guard observing only]
A proven-but-never-attached account is NOT verified (creation alone verifies nothing)
Five wrong codes close the challenge; the correct code afterwards is refused
A number that already belongs to an account gets the SAME reply shape, nothing is delivered (deliver=false), and its code can never verify
Email + password sign-up is unaffected
Email OTP (passwordless / sign-up code) is unaffected: the OTP request succeeds and creates the user row
Email recovery request is unaffected
Email + password sign-in of an existing account and legacy phone-alias sign-in are unaffected
Google-shaped, Facebook-without-e-mail and Facebook-unverified-e-mail users are created (the guard's WHEN clause never selects them)
Legacy Installer, Showroom and e-mail identities are byte-identical (auth row, password digest, identities, MFA, profile, verified flag, memberships, consents) after every attack
All legacy accounts still sign in with their original passwords
Legacy numbers stay UNVERIFIED (nothing in this suite writes their phone_verified_at)
No duplicate alias identity exists in the whole database
